description: Explain a concept in context by getting it together with the glossary entries editors linked as related, in their chosen order, with absolute url links. Accepts an ID, title, or alias. Neighbors default to full; compact detail shortens neighbors while keeping the main entry full.

detail.description: "full" returns complete related entries (default); "compact" returns neighbor summaries. The main entry always stays full.

id.description: Entry ID, title, or alias, for example "rag", "Vector Database", or "retrieval augmented generation".

name: get_related_terms
title: Get related entries
